explication: RetroArch is a portable libretro frontend. A user launches content or issues a command; command and configuration handling select content and a core, the core runs through the frontend lifecycle, and callback-driven input, audio, and video reach platform backends. The graph also preserves playlist management, cheats, achievements, AI, shaders, camera/Bluetooth input, and Wii-specific storage. Several capabilities are represented from the README and tree, while unsampled internal wiring is intentionally limited.
